title: MIRAGE: Multi-Perspective Creative Language Model Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.21554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence and how human interact with AIs. Despite impressive advancements, LLMs struggle with complex mathematical, scientific, and logical tasks. Inspired by human cognitive flexibility - our ability to dynamically switch mental perspectives - we propose MIRAGE (Multi-perspective Inference-time Reasoning via Agent-Guided Exploration), a novel inference-time creative thinking framework. translated_title: MIRAGE：基于强化学习引导的多视角创造性语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展彻底改变了人工智能以及人类与AI交互的方式。尽管取得了令人瞩目的进步，LLMs在复杂的数学、科学和逻辑任务上仍然表现不佳。受人类认知灵活性——即动态切换思维视角的能力——的启发，我们提出了MIRAGE（通过智能体引导探索的多视角推理时推理），这是一种新颖的推理时创造性思维框架。MIRAGE包含一个选择器，用于优先选择有效的概念视角（例如代数、概率视角），以及一个推理器，它按顺序解决任务直到出现有把握的解决方案，否则聚合多个视角的推理结果。在GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro和Game-of-24基准测试中，MIRAGE始终优于思维链和多样化提示集成等方法，以最小的推理开销显著提升了准确性，并提供了可扩展的……（原文截断）
tldr: MIRAGE是一个受人类认知灵活性启发的推理时创造性思维框架，通过选择器优先选择有效概念视角、推理器依次求解并在必要时聚合多视角结果，在多个基准测试中以最小推理开销显著超越思维链等方法的准确性。
en_tdlr: MIRAGE is an inference-time creative thinking framework inspired by human cognitive flexibility, which uses a Selector to prioritize effective conceptual perspectives and a Reasoner to sequentially solve tasks or aggregate multi-perspective results, significantly outperforming Chain-of-Thought with minimal inference overhead across multiple benchmarks.
